source.title: Explaining the symptoms of schizophrenia: abnormalities in the awareness of action

confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily replicated formulation of the comparator/forward-model account, and the mapping to ARC-015 is close to literal: a mechanism that derives the predicted consequences of one's own action from the intended motor commands, whose failure produces both a phenomenological deficit (delusions of control) and a computational one (loss of central error correction, failure to attenuate self-caused sensation). That the failure is clinically recognisable is the strongest available argument that the machinery is REQUIRED rather than merely useful, which is exactly ARC-015's modal force. Held at 0.8 rather than higher because it is a 2000 theoretical review whose specific disconnection story has since been complicated, and because it concerns sensorimotor self-attribution rather than the full responsibility-flow ARC-015 also asserts.
failure_signatures: Without a forward model deriving predicted consequences from the efferent copy, self-generated sensory consequences are not attenuated and are processed as externally caused -- the concrete mechanism by which a system loses the ability to tell its own effects from the world's.

The same failure removes CENTRAL error correction: the agent can no longer correct an action against its own predicted outcome, only against externally observed outcome. Self-impact attribution is therefore load-bearing for control, not only for the experience of agency.

Delusions of control are accompanied by OVER-activity in parietal cortex, i.e. the failure is a failure to inhibit/attenuate, not an absence of signal -- an architecture missing the attribution channel does not go quiet, it over-reports.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The primary cognitive deficit underlying delusions of control is a failure in the mechanism by which the predicted consequences of an action are derived from a forward model based on the intended sequence of motor commands. This produces a lack of central error correction and a failure to attenuate responses to self-generated sensations, and is associated with parietal over-activity attributed to cortico-cortical disconnection preventing frontal inhibitory signals from reaching sensory areas.
mapping.ree_translation: Self-impact attribution is not an optional refinement but a structural requirement: a system that cannot derive, from its own committed action, what consequences it should expect to cause will (a) misattribute self-caused evidence to the world and (b) lose the ability to correct against its own predictions. This is the substrate reading of ARC-015's MECH-095 comparator and of the channel separation in MECH-060/061/066/067 -- the prediction channel and the observation channel must remain distinguishable at the point of comparison.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper's domain is sensorimotor self-attribution over a short horizon -- limb movement, tickling, immediate sensory consequence. ARC-015 additionally asserts RESPONSIBILITY FLOW, i.e. attribution over extended causal chains and over consequences that are not sensory returns of one's own body. The extension from efference-copy attenuation to responsibility flow is an inference this paper does not make; the specific cortico-cortical disconnection account has also been complicated by later work even though the comparator framing has held.
mapping.source_context: Human clinical/theoretical review, schizophrenia with delusions of control; motor control and sensory attenuation paradigms.

confidence_components.notes: mapping_fidelity is high because ARC-015 is an architectural_commitment and this paper supplies the canonical statement of the same architecture. The pathology evidence is what converts 'useful' into 'required', which is the modal claim ARC-015 makes.
